title: In Vitro Model of Physiological and Pathological Blood Flow with Application to Investigations of Vascular Cell Remodeling
protocol: Immerse new glass slides measuring 75 mm by 50 mm by 1 mm in sulfuric acid (20%) overnight.
Wash the slides by immersing them in deionized water for 5 minutes, repeating three times with fresh deionized water each time.
Immerse the slides in acetone for 30 minutes.
Immerse the slides in a 6% (3-aminopropyl)triethoxysilane/acetone solution overnight.
Immerse the slides in acetone for 5 minutes, repeating three times with fresh acetone each time.
Consult MSDS for acetone before use.
Wash slide by immersing in DI for 5 min, three times, changing DI each time.
Immerse slide in 1.5% glutaraldehyde / DI solution for 60 min.
Consult MSDS for glutaraldehyde before use.
Wash slide by immersing in DI for 5 min, two times, changing DI each time.
Place slides into 70% ethanol (EtOH) for 30 min in sterile, laminar flow hood.
Remove EtOH and allow remaining residue to evaporate.
Immerse slides in sterile DI and drain in order to rehydrate the slides.
Place silicone gasket on top of the slide.
Prepare 1 ml SMC in 10% FBS/DMEM suspension.
Neutralize 1 ml solution of 2 mg/ml collagen type-I with 7% NaHCO3 and 0.1 M NaOH to pH of 7.4.
Mix neutralized collagen solution with SMC suspension to achieve a final cell density of 2 x 10^6 cells/ml.
Spread the SMC solution within the gasket on the slide.
Incubate slides at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 30 min.
Cover the slide with 25 ml 0.1% fetal bovine serum (FBS) mixed in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM).
Culture endothelial cells (ECs) on fibronectin surfaces of glass slide or polycarbonate membrane.
Seed 1 ml ECs in 10% FBS/DMEM with an initial concentration of 6.0 x 10^5 cells/ml.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37 °C, 5% CO2, and 10% FBS for 120 min.
Cover slides containing cells with additional 10% FBS/DMEM.
Place slides in incubator overnight at 37 °C, 5% CO2 until confluent (70%-80%).
Measure 1% FBS/DMEM viscosity using a rotational viscometer.
Determine required volumetric flow rate (Q) from Poiseuille equation.
Set pump to flow rate derived in step 2.3.
Connect flow circuit as described with damping chamber and ultrasonic flow meter.
Fill flow circuit and reservoir with DI water.
Visualize flow waveform using a flow meter.
Open air release valve on the damping chamber.
Close air release valve at different fluid level intervals.
Calculate pulsatility index (PI = (VMax - VMin) / VMean).
Record PI values in notebook.
Mark resulting fluid level and PI on the damping chamber.
Mix the silicone elastomer base and curing agent at different ratios as needed.
Fabricate silicone tubes by dipping steel cannula into the silicone prepolymer mixture.
Place the prepolymer-coated cannula into an oven set at 60 °C for 4 hr to cure.
Switch the direction of the cannula in the middle of the curing process.
Repeat the dipping and curing process with the same silicone elastomer mixture.
Remove the ultrathin silicone tube from the stainless steel cannula after curing is complete.
Immerse the flow chamber, PVC tubing, and gaskets in 10% hydrogen peroxide (H2O2).
Wash all components with sterile DI water.
Fill the flow circuit and reservoir with 10% H2O2 by submerging outlet tube.
Circulate H2O2 through the circuit for 20 min under UV light in a laminar flow hood.
Aspirate all H2O2 from tubing.
Wash with sterile PBS by pumping through flow circuit.
Warm up 1% FBS/DMEM in a 37 °C water bath.
Prepare flow chamber.
Take EC slide out of media.
Place gasket on top of EC slide with cell side up.
(Optional) Take PC membrane out of media.
Place gasket on top of PC membrane with cell side up.
Place co-culture slide with seeded SMC underneath PC membrane.
Align vacuum channel of the flow chamber with holes in the gasket.
Attach vacuum tube to vacuum ports ensuring no media leaks to vacuum.
Place polycarbonate sheet underneath glass slide.
Clamp flow chamber assembly with spring clamps, one on each side of flow chamber.
Place flow system in incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Fill circuit with media by pumping from filled reservoir at low pulsatility.
Maintain this flow for 4 hr for preconditioning cells.
Adjust fluid volume in damping chamber to marked PI level.
Culture for desired time.
